name: Brand-wise Stock Report
query:
SELECT 
    i.brand AS "Brand",  
    i.item_code AS "Item Code",  
    i.item_name AS "Item Name",  
    sle.warehouse AS "Warehouse",  
    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS "Total Stock"  
FROM 
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle  
JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON sle.item_code = i.item_code  
WHERE 
    sle.docstatus = 1  -- Consider only submitted stock entries  
    AND sle.warehouse != 'Damaged Stocks - SC'  -- Exclude damaged stock warehouse
GROUP BY 
    i.brand, i.item_code, sle.warehouse  
ORDER BY 
    i.brand ASC, i.item_code ASC;
